answer: Seed the queue with tasks whose answers are already known. A submission that matches the bad answer marks the account as a copier. Cap one submission per identity per epoch. Rotate auditors so the same panel never grades the same farm twice. A copier hits the honeypot on the first task and loses the epoch. A harvester of a thousand identities pays a thousand registrations for one poisoned result. The glacier moves slowly; the tide of clones hits it all at once. Cost: one epoch lost per account, plus a flag that follows the fingerprint to its zenith.
